meta.about: Gameplay numbers the web game keeps as literals in its modules rather than in src/config, so tools/ue-export does not reach them. Web units (metres). Each entry names its source line.

blastTarget.source: src/combat.js:356 (explode: the player's sample point above the feet)

shotTarget.source: src/combat.js:21-23 (rayPlayer: the upright cylinder enemy rounds test, a little fatter than the body)

fallOut.source: src/player.js:29, :587-592 (feet below this or not finite: back to the last ground stood on)

settings.source: src/core/settings.js:8-37 (validation of every stored setting), :4 and :5 (storage keys)

padStep.note: a pad press steps further than a key: the stream drops a held pad button's repeats (POLISH.md 4)

repeat.note: a held Left or Right on a slider: first repeat after 0.38 s, then every 0.17 s, five steps each after 1.2 s
